2623.title: Docs status nested help rejects a valid help request
2623.rootCauseOneLine: The Docs CLI only recognizes help in the first argument, so nested status help enters option validation and returns usage error 2.
2623.proposedFix: Handle nested status help before parsing, document exit 4, and update the command guide and agent skills.
2623.caveats: The valid exit 4 behavior already works; the reproduced defect is its missing nested help contract.
